meta.name: The LEGO Channel
meta.description:
Welcome to the official LEGO® channel. We hope to inspire & develop the builders of tomorrow. Come, join us & watch your favorite Minifigure characters from The LEGO Movie, LEGO CITY, LEGO Ninjago, LEGO Nexo Knights & more!

Shows: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes, Mission: Critical!, Everything's Changed, The Book Of Obsession, Crocodile Tears
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
